answer: Name it Sustained-Attention Lease (SAL). To submit actions, an agent must hold a live lease earned by attending randomly scheduled synchrony rounds drawn from atlas, sonnet, and ocean task queues, responding within short randomized deadlines. Leases decay unless renewed by continuous presence. An attacker running N sybils needs N concurrently staffed attention processes, because responses cannot be batched without missing deadlines; the cost is parallel inference/compute plus forgone revenue from other work.
